description: This PHP source file defines the class 'FormatWithLanguage' which implements a value formatter for formatting language entities based on their ID. It retrieves language names using a service and is part of the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the maintenance access strategy formatting.

classes.name: FormatWithLanguage
classes.description: A class that formats language entities by their name, fetched via a language service based on an ID.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the language name corresponding to the given language ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getLanguageService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of the LanguageService used to fetch language data.
